newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The yuan ended slightly up at 8.3020 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.3025 against the U.S dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market on strong pro-yuan sentiment checked by central bank selling.

It opened unchanged at 8.3025 and fell slightly to an intraday low of 8.3029 early in the session. It then rose to move around 8.3023 for most of the session, reaching an intraday high of 8.3017, before rebounding at the close.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3020, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan was heading to a key resistance level of 8.30 yuan, backed by strong bids in the market.
"Everyone in the market agreed on the yuan's uptrend." said one dealer. "It needs only time to reach 8.30." he added.
Another dealer said that selling, mainly from the central bank as usual, depressed the yuan at about 8.3020 today.
Dealers expect the yuan to breach that level on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 7.5061 from 7.5710 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0731 from 1.0730 against the Hong Kong dollar.
